key_insight: BAR makes LLM reasoning over medical knowledge graphs budget-aware and citation-backed by ranking evidence quality, planning retrieval steps, and verifying each claim.
clinical_relevance: For post-discharge risk prediction, this could help clinicians get more trustworthy, traceable explanations from external medical knowledge without unbounded retrieval cost.
method: Builds disease-specific evidence graphs from a medical KG with support scores and provenance.
Uses an LLM plan-navigate-verify loop to retrieve evidence under a patient-specific budget and revise when verification fails.
Trains a reasoning policy with rewards for predictive gain, lower acquisition cost, and citation integrity.
evidence_signal: On MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons, BAR improved AUPRC by 3.4 points, raised citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and used only 62-65% of the budget cap.
watch_item: Performance and citation quality depend on the underlying KG coverage and provenance quality, so incomplete or noisy graph evidence may still limit real-world reliability.
paper_title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
